places.name: Cologne Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the largest Gothic cathedrals in Europe, known for its twin spires.

opening_hours.notes: Tower climb has separate timings.

places.place_tip: Climb the south tower for panoramic views of Cologne.

places.ai_summary: A luxury shopping boulevard lined with high-end boutiques, restaurants, and a picturesque canal.

opening_hours.notes: Shops have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the cafes along the canal.

places.name: Bonn Beethoven House
places.ai_summary: The birthplace of Ludwig van Beethoven, now a museum dedicated to his life and works.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check for special exhibitions during your visit.

places.ai_summary: A stunning example of Carolingian architecture and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its octagonal basilica.

opening_hours.notes: Treasury has separate admission fee.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Palatine Chapel inside the cathedral.

places.ai_summary: A prominent landmark in Düsseldorf, this tower offers an observation deck with panoramic views of the city and the Rhine River.

opening_hours.notes: Last elevator ride to the top at 22:00.

places.place_tip: Book a table at the restaurant for a special dining experience with a view.

places.name: Zeche Zollverein Essen
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this former coal mine is now a museum and cultural venue, known for its industrial architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours recommended.

places.place_tip: Visit the Red Dot Design Museum located on the site.

places.ai_summary: A popular theme park in Germany, featuring a variety of rides, shows, and themed areas for all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Check website for seasonal opening times.

places.place_tip: Try to visit during the week to avoid large crowds.

places.ai_summary: The historic heart of Cologne, featuring narrow streets, traditional houses, and the famous Cologne Cathedral.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and restaurants have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Alter Markt square for a taste of local life.

places.ai_summary: A scenic cruise on the Rhine River, offering beautiful views of the riverbanks, vineyards, and castles.

opening_hours.notes: Book in advance for popular routes.

places.best_time_to_visit: Match days for a lively experience
places.place_tip: Try the local sausage (Currywurst) at the stadium.
